The center provides inpatient and outpatient care aimed at supporting conditions such as depression, anxiety, and trauma. U-center serves individuals seeking mental health rehabilitation. It was founded in 2008 and is based in Limburg, Netherlands. Headquarters Location Julianastraat 23a Limburg, 6285, Netherlands 0800-2224446 Latest U-center News Booking.com leased 8.000 square meters in U Center Bucharest Feb 7, 2022 publicat acum 6 ore 55 de minute Booking.com leased the space in the first phase of the U Center office project in Bucharest for its inaugural Center of Excellence. The center serves as a hub for specialized and highly skilled talent, software development and collaboration opportunities across various brands and business units of Booking Holdings. With the signing of this transaction, the office space in the first phase of U Center, with a gross leasable area (GLA) of over 32.000 square meters, is 100% leased. Completed in Q3 2021, the first phase of the U Center office project obtained LEED Platinum certification with a score of 85 and WELL Health & Safety. This is one of the highest LEED v4 certifications obtained in Romania and certifies the sanitary safety of the building in the context of COVID-19. Construction works on the second phase of the project were started in H2 2021. The two phases of U Center have a GLA of 63.000 square meters, including a retail component on the ground floors. Introduction This document provides information about troubleshooting common issues with U-Center 2.0. Restrictions and guidelines To help identify the cause of the issue, collect detailed system and network information, including but not limited to the following: · Record the U-Center 2.0 components and versions, Matrix version, and operating system version. · Symptom, time of failure, and configuration. · Network topology information, including the network diagram, port connections, and points of failure. · Collect the log and diagnostic information (see "Collecting fault information"). · Record the operations that you have performed and their effects. Applicable component versions Unless otherwise stipulated, this guide applies to all U-Center 2.0 versions. Collecting fault information You can collect the U-Center 2.0 running information as follows: 1. Enter the U-Center 2.0 login address http://ip_address:30000 in a browser and press Enter. Enter the username and password, and then click Log In. 2. On the U-Center 2.0 Web interface, navigate to the System > Log Management > Diag Log List page to access the running log entries page, as shown in Figure 1. Click the Global Logs or Node Logs tab. You can perform the following tasks: ¡ Specify the directory (relative path), start time, and end time to view the global log or node log files in the specified directory within the selected time span. ¡ Select the target logs and click Export to export the selected global logs or node logs to your local host. If you click Export without selecting any logs, all global logs or node logs will be exported. Figure 1 Running log entries page Technical support If you cannot resolve the fault, collect the device running information and fault information, and contact Technical Support at email address service@h3c.com Troubleshooting IOM The APM component menus (such as server and storage) are not available Symptom The Web interface does not display APM menus including servers and storage. Figure 2 No APM menus Troubleshooting procedure If the Web interface does not display APM menus including servers and storage, perform the following tasks: 1. Verify that the following licenses exist on the license server (the license names might differ in earlier versions): ¡ H3C U-Center2.0, IOM License (IOM feature license) ¡ H3C U-Center2.0, IOM, XXX License (IOM quantity license) ¡ H3C U-Center2.0, Intelligent Operations Platform Software 2. Log in to U-Center 2.0, access the System > License Management > License Information page, and identify whether the license list contains the following three licenses: Figure 3 License information 3. Identify whether the IOM package is installed and whether the service is running correctly. Figure 4 Identify whether IOM is installed 4. If the issue persists, obtain detailed information including the version, environment, issue description, screenshots, and logs, and then contact Technical Support. Service not started Symptom If the IOM service is not running, the page will display request failure or 404 NOT FOUND messages. Troubleshooting procedure If the IOM service is not running, perform the following tasks: 1. Verify that the IOM package is installed with adequate, and the upgrade path is correct. For example: A Java collector exception and continuous reboot issue occurred in version E0704H03 at a deployment site. The fault reason is that, for the upgrade from E0612, the deployment site directly used the IOM package of E0704H03, which was a hot patch not including all IOM components. This resulted in the lack of necessary basic components after the upgrade, causing services to malfunction. The correct upgrade path for U-Center 2.0 IOM is E0612-E0704-E0704P02-E0704H03. 2. Identify whether the service pod is running correctly. For example: Figure 5 Identify whether the service pod is running correctly 3. If the state is pending, the possible reason is insufficient environment resources. Execute the following command to locate the detailed cause: kubectl -n service-software describe po pod name For example: kubectl -n service-software describe po itom-apm-rs-77576568d-z6hd4 4. The Events content shows the detailed cause for the pod scheduling failure, for example, insufficient CPU or memory resources. Figure 6 Events content 5. If the issue persists, obtain detailed information including the version, environment, issue description, screenshots, and logs, and then contact Technical Support. No threshold alarms exist Symptom The thresholds configured in the monitoring template cannot trigger alarms. Troubleshooting procedure 1. Verify that the threshold settings in the monitor template are correct. For example, whether the operators are correct, threshold alarm is enabled, and the number of triggering times is reached. Figure 7 Threshold configuration 2. Access the Alarm > Traps > Trap List page to identify whether the alarm trap has been sent, whether it has been filtered, and whether alarm rules have been configured. Figure 8 Checking the alarm traps 3. Identify whether the monitoring status is listing and whether the related configuration parameter for listing has been disabled. Figure 9 Listing configuration 4. Identify whether the alarm has been manually cleared and whether the Continue to trigger after manual alert clearance parameter is disabled on the Monitor > Monitoring Options > Parameter Settings page. Figure 10 Parameter configuration 5. Identify whether the itom-alarm-calculator and itom-alarm-dm services are running correctly. 6. If the issue persists, obtain detailed information including the version, environment, issue description, screenshots, and logs, and then contact Technical Support. No metric data Symptom No data is collected for monitoring metrics. Troubleshooting procedure 1. Identify whether the monitoring template in use has been configured with the metric group and metrics. 2. (When no data is collected for all metrics) Identify whether the monitoring resource is in listing state and whether data collection is disabled on the Monitor > Monitoring Options > Listing Tasks > Resource Listing > Listing Configuration page. 3. (When no data is collected for all metrics) If the monitored resource belongs to a lower-level proxy, identify whether the hub services (itom-client-hub-rs and itom-server-hub) for both the upper-level and lower-level environments are running correctly. 4. Review the log files for the Java collector and C++ collector (for SSH, TELNET, SNMP, WMI, and PING protocols, check the C++ collector logs. For other protocols, check the Java collector logs). ¡ Java collector search keywords: <appType>-<metric group id>-<monitoring resource id>, for example, cas-vmNet-361576116784069. ¡ C++ collector search keywords: uuid=< monitoring resource id>_<collection task id>_<task version number> unitname=< metric group id>, for example, uuid=361576116781881_73_1 unitname=cpuinfo_stat. 5. If the issue persists, obtain detailed information including the version, environment, issue description, screenshots, and logs, and then contact Technical Support. Connectivity test timed out Symptom The connectivity test to the monitoring resource timed out. Troubleshooting procedure 1. Identify whether the itom-apm-ui, itom-apm-rs, itom-cmc, itom-data-dispatcher, itom-task-dispatcher, itom-collector-java, itom-collector-cpp, and etcd service pods are running correctly. 2. Log in to the U-Center 2.0 back-end server and use the telnet command to identify whether the IP and port are allowed. Figure 11 Checking the IP and port 3. If the monitoring resource belongs to a subordinate proxy, identify whether the hub services (itom-client-hub-rs and itom-server-hub) in both the superior and subordinate environments are running correctly. 4. For Oracle and MySQL monitoring resources, use a third-party client tool to identify whether you can connect and access the resources within the same network as U-Center 2.0. 5.
